annotations.title: Read tickets opened and closed over 1, 7 or 30 company-local calendar days or all recorded history

description: Read tickets opened and closed over 1, 7 or 30 company-local calendar days or all recorded history. Includes zero-filled hourly, daily or monthly bars, period totals, open tickets now and closures without usable dates. rolling contains a dense series of original-timestamp trailing counts with windowSeconds, stepSeconds, from and points (at, opened, closed). Windows are one hour for 1d, 24 hours for 7d/30d, and 24 hours, 7 days, 30 days or 365 days for all-time depending on history length. At most 722 points include the exact observation time; lookback before the selected period is included in rolling counts, while period totals remain exact calendar counts. Reopened tickets are open; a completed run is not a closure. Changes nothing.

period.description: Company-local calendar days including today. 1d is hourly today; all includes full recorded history, grouped monthly after 120 days.
